observations: Steal An Egg, Brookhaven, Murder Mystery 2, 99 Nights in the Forest and RIVALS hold the top again, so the top of the chart stayed put for another day.
Racing and co-op games led the risers: Backseat Rally (+37, 16 days), Drag Drive Simulator (+27), Save the Krusty Krab (+27, 22 days) and Make Ramen To Get Rich (+18, 13 days).
The fallers were mostly young casual and job sims, Paint a Pancake (-26), Wash the Car (-18) and WRONG WAY! (-13), plus Piggy (-18) after its Halloween lift faded.
Nine new entries include Realistic Phone Drop Test, Bike Universe, Fake an Egg and Eat Everything In A Grocery Store, all 17–24 days old; Apple iPad Original and Dragon Adventures fell off.
By age, games past a year still score best (median percentile 61), while 15–84-day games remain the weakest (35–37).
patterns: Bigger servers consistently go with higher positions (H-mp-007 strengthened to 71%), and multiplayer loops tend to beat solo ones (H-mp-003 at 68%).
Pricier products and passes go with longer stays (rho +0.30 and +0.28). Passes priced above 149 R$ tend to go with higher positions (68%).
Recent updates go with staying power (days since update vs days on chart, rho -0.26). Weekly updates tend to hold (H-mp-018 at 65%).
Among profiled loops, combat PvP (median percentile 71), roleplay (70) and pet hatching (74) score highest. Idle tycoons (27) and collect-upgrade-rebirth loops (31) score lowest.

outliers.name: Drag Drive Simulator
outliers.note: A 644-day-old game climbing 27 places after a big wheelie update, which fits the realistic-vehicle niche idea (H-x-010).

outliers.name: Fake an Egg
outliers.note: A 17-day-old steal/egg clone entering Most Popular, against the claim that the steal wave is fading (H-x-011).

observations: Donation hubs again lead monetization efficiency (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS), followed by Elemental Dungeons, Spin a KPOP Idol and Dinosaur Simulator.
The weakest are young games whose players arrived before revenue did: Sell Fries! [Anomaly] (30 days), Cat Battles (16) and Climb For Animals Eggs (45), plus the 720-day-old Violence District.
Big risers mixed young RNG games (Roll A Stickman +153) with older PvP titles (War of the Worlds +129, Da Hood +118). Steal and egg games fell hardest (Steal A Baddie Egg -79, Shoot For Eggs -74).
21 new entries include licensed and long-running titles: SpongeBob Tower Defense, Anime Dimensions Simulator and MEDVED. Newer ones include Run an Airline and Collect Cat Cards.
Efficiency again rises with age, from a median percentile of 22 at 15–42 days to 59 past a year.
patterns: Games older than six weeks consistently earn more for their CCU (78%), so most other Top Earning associations are partly about age.
Price ladders consistently go with efficiency: a median product above 79 R$ (rho +0.30), a median pass above 399 R$ and a premium pass above 999 R$.

RPGs (r +0.47), roleplay hubs (+0.30) and PvP combat consistently monetize well. Simulation-genre games (-0.23), solo loops (-0.22) and pet, egg and steal loops monetize poorly. A new hypothesis tests solo loops directly.
Studio-scale complexity (rho +0.25) and longer descriptions (+0.25) go with efficiency, though both overlap with game age and genre.

outliers.name: [🎃] Spin a KPOP Idol
outliers.note: A 180-day-old RNG simulator among the most efficient games, which is unusual for a simulator. A fandom audience and a 120-product ladder likely explain it.

outliers.name: [UPD]Verity Evolution
outliers.note: A 30-day-old pet and evolution simulator that sits higher than its loop predicts. Steep 2,999 R$ fusion passes may explain it, in line with the premium-pass pattern.

observations: Clone Baby Care (Anomaly, 12 days) leads momentum (+40), alongside physics sandboxes Crazy Diver and Bike Universe and the cozy tycoon Make Rugs!.
DIVINE HATCHERS took the biggest climb (+59) despite the pet/egg momentum pattern; Feed A Mosquito (+37) and Makeup Salon (+33) followed.
WRONG WAY! (-24), Country Battles (-27) and Rush To The Vet! (-32) fell. Rush To The Vet! has a 59% like ratio.
20 new entries, including DONT SPLASH at 4 days old, Steel Fighters, Something is Wrong With My Dog and Solve The Cube. RIVALS and Murder Mystery 2 fell off.
15–42-day games have the best momentum (median percentile 65); games under 15 days score only 30, since many are still settling.
patterns: Young games with a collection index tend to hold higher positions (H-tt-028 strengthened to 66%, within-age effect +0.46).
Many passes go with lower positions (passes_n vs tt_pos rho -0.36, within-age -0.35, best split at 8). A new hypothesis tests a cap at 8 passes.
'+1' titles tend to hold lower positions (r -0.43 within age); the existing '+1' momentum hypothesis stays at 57%.
More complex games climb slightly faster (rho +0.28), and physics sandboxes have the highest median percentile among loops (93), though only 4 games are profiled.

outliers.name: DIVINE HATCHERS 0.0001% [NEW!]
outliers.note: A pet hatcher with 167 products climbing +59, against both the pet/egg and many-products patterns. Its extreme-rarity title hook may drive curiosity.

outliers.name: [💌] Roll a Fat Friend [2 Players Obby]
outliers.note: A 646-day-old game re-entering, but it is outside the 4-month momentum window. A two-player obby revival suggests co-op formats can resurface.

observations: Clone Baby Care, Bike Universe, Backseat Rally, Cat Battles, Steel Fighters and Fix My Phone! lead Up-and-Coming. All but Steel Fighters (44 days) are 12–24 days old.
Solve The Cube (+64), Fix My Phone! (+44) and DIVINE HATCHERS (+38) rose most, while Makeup Star (-44, 57% likes) and Secure The Hospital (-57, 71% likes) fell hardest.
14 new entries, including +1 Slinky Escape, Train Pets for Eggs, Lanterns and Smash Bro!; 17 fell off, including Feed A Mosquito and VANITY.
Games under 15 days score best (median percentile 65), against 48 for 15–84 days.
patterns: Build and crafting loops tend to rank lower (r -0.40, within-age -0.57; H-uc-029 at 65%), and cash-tycoon loops do too (66%).
'Play with friends' co-op pitches tend to rank lower (H-uc-013 strengthened to 64%), but co-op loops in general have weakened to 48%, which suggests the pitch wording matters more than the loop.
Everyday-life roleplay mechanics go with higher positions (r +0.38) and are now a new hypothesis. Recent updates tend to help (H-uc-012 at 66%).
Low like ratios go with the steepest falls (Makeup Star, Secure The Hospital, Rush To The Vet!), in line with H-uc-006 (60%).

outliers.name: Steel Fighters
outliers.note: A 44-day-old robot-building collect-and-rebirth game in the top six, against both the build-loop and age patterns. The Real Steel hook and a +50% friends bonus may carry it.

outliers.name: Cat Battles 🐾
outliers.note: Near the top of Up-and-Coming with a 74% like ratio and 196 products, while it is among the weakest on Top Earning efficiency. Reach still comes before revenue.

summary: Games pull players first and monetize later: the newest games lead Up-and-Coming and Top Trending, while Top Earning efficiency rises steadily with age (median percentile 22 at 15–42 days to 59 past a year).

Launching lean (8 or fewer passes, no auto-play passes) goes with better breakout and momentum, while steep price ladders go with efficiency in older games. Monetization depth looks like something to add after breakout.

Remakes of viral indie games (a Minecraft-style dog horror, a Cuphead-style boss rush, a Poolrooms stealth obby) and two-player co-op racers entered the breakout charts this week, while young steal/egg clones are mixed: some enter Most Popular as others drop on Top Earning.
Halloween tags are everywhere this week, so seasonal lift is a confounder for update and bracket-tag effects.
progressions: tt→mp remains the most common transition (82, median 2 days), followed by uc→tt (80, 2 days) and te→tt (57, 7 days).
uc→te (51, 4 days) and uc→mp (47, 4 days) show breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within a week, while tt→uc stays at 1, so the sequence still runs from Up-and-Coming first.
